limits: This is local batch admission, not cross-file atomic filesystem reading or an OS sandbox.
Only the direct file selector supports batches; commands, slash parameters and inline @ remain single selection.
Uncommitted baskets are discarded on close; all selected paths are revalidated by existing backends before admission.
No binary transfer, full repository index or new model schema/configuration setting.
Platform skips are not passes. No remote native CI or full Python/client/macOS matrix claim.
